remediationPlan.title: Remediation Plan

steps: Review the cited advisories and release notes for lodash 4.17.21; compare with installed 4.17.20. Compatibility has not been tested.

In package-lock.json, locate the owning package.json declaration (including aliases) and update its declared dependency to the verified candidate 4.17.21. Preserve the intended runtime/dev/optional role.

Regenerate the affected lockfile in your controlled development environment, review the diff, and ensure every affected installation path is replaced. Do not edit a nested node_modules copy as the fix.
validation: Run the project's actual regression, integration, and build checks in a trusted environment; resolve major-version migration requirements.
Rescan the updated manifests and lockfiles and rerun OSV checks for all affected instances, including duplicate versions.
Revisit scoped function reachability with verified affected-export mappings. Separately review runtime feasibility, attacker control, deployment exposure, and mitigations.
